headline: Northern Fronts Shift as Marban Hollow and Linn of Mercy Flare
war_summary: Fierce fighting along the northern battle line has shifted its sharpest intensity back toward Marban Hollow and Linn of Mercy. In Marban Hollow, clashes around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall generated five base transitions in the past two hours under accelerating casualty rates. Linn of Mercy continues its ferocious grind, sustaining over sixteen hundred combined casualties in the latest hour alongside persistent base churn between Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Weathered Expanse remains partitioned and turbulent, logging three recent base events with three strongholds left destroyed in no-man's-land. While Nevish Line recorded no base captures over the past two hours, combat losses there surged sharply once again. Fresh turnover has also ignited in Mooring County at The Wind Hills and across Stlican Shelf at Briar, with both sectors logging two base transitions during the latest two-hour window. Meanwhile, intense attrition persists in Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle without recent territorial shifts, leaving the central and southern reaches quiet.
